newsitem.title: FRANCE: RFS gains new business from Air France.
newsitem.headline: RFS gains new business from Air France.

text.p: Road Flight Systems (RFS), a road haulage company specialising in freight transported under air way bill, said it had picked up new business from Air France earlier this month.
"Since January 5, we have been operating a daily road service between the Paris airports (CDG and Orly) and Lille transporting Air France cargo," an RFS official told Reuters.
"This service was previously operated on behalf of Air France by Lille-based haulage company, Cardon, the official said.

"We are currently in discussions with Air France and other airlines on the subject of new road services for airfreight which could necessitate increasing the size of our fleet which currently totals around 45 vehicles," the official added.
RFS is owned by French haulage group, Bourgey-Montreuil. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
